prompt.generated_prompt_string: A raw smartphone 0.5x ultra-wide fashion candid of an adult woman in an empty rooftop parking garage at blue hour. Windblown dark hair partly crosses her face; she wears dark glossy lipstick, an oversized vintage leather jacket, black tailored trousers, black ankle boots, and chunky silver rings. She sits side-on on the cold concrete with knees bent to one side, leaning lightly against one hand and looking toward the lens with a reserved expression. Include industrial concrete pillars, yellow parking lines, a sprawling out-of-focus skyline, deep blue sky, and a distant warm sodium lamp. Use teal-and-amber contrast, velvety shadows, slight digital noise, subtle hair motion blur, and raw nocturnal photo-dump texture without body exaggeration.
